dialogue.speaker: Hermione Granger
dialogue.text: Put that wand away, Harry! It's past midnight, and if a professor catches us outside the dormitory, Gryffindor will lose fifty house points—or worse, we'll be expelled!

dialogue.speaker: Harry Potter
dialogue.text: I'm not waiting until morning, Hermione. Someone is trying to steal whatever is hidden on the third floor tonight, and I have to stop them.

dialogue.speaker: Ron Weasley
dialogue.text: Couldn't they steal it tomorrow after breakfast? I'm freezing, it's pitch-black out there, and I'd really rather keep my head attached to my shoulders.

dialogue.speaker: Hermione Granger
dialogue.text: For once, Ron is making sense. We are twelve years old—we barely know half the defensive spells in our textbooks!

dialogue.speaker: Harry Potter
dialogue.text: I didn't ask either of you to come with me. Go back to bed if you want, but I'm going up to the third floor right now.

dialogue.speaker: Ron Weasley
dialogue.text: Oh, brilliant, make me feel guilty. Grab your wand, Hermione—we can't let him get himself killed without us.
